definitions.gloss: true feelings; real intention; what one really thinks
definitions.explanation: One's genuine thoughts or feelings as opposed to what one expresses publicly for social harmony.

examples.japanese: {本音|ほんね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧⟦{行|い}きたくない→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: To tell you the truth, I don't really want to go.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本音|ほんね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦{分|わ}かった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I finally understood his true feelings.
When people drink alcohol, their true feelings come out.

notes:
CULTURAL CONCEPT:
{本音|ほんね} and ⟦{建前|たてまえ}→建前：06621_tatemae⟧ are a fundamental pair in understanding Japanese communication. {本音|ほんね} represents one's genuine, private thoughts while ⟦{建前|たてまえ}→建前：06621_tatemae⟧ is the public stance maintained for social harmony.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{本音|ほんね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ / {本音|ほんね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吐|は}く→吐く：04397_haku⟧ (to speak one's true feelings)
・{本音|ほんね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (one's true feelings come out)
・{本音|ほんね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{隠|かく}す→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧ (to hide one's true feelings)
・{本音|ほんね}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{建前|たてまえ}→建前：06621_tatemae⟧ (true feelings and public stance)

USAGE NOTE:
Often used when revealing something that contrasts with what was previously expressed or expected.
